instruction: Transform the video file "Baby Justin Bieber.mp4" on the desktop into an audio-only MP3 file. Save the extracted audio with the same name "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires transforming video to audio-only MP3 file. Evaluator checks file exists with minimum 150KB size to verify proper audio extraction occurred.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete semantic verification: Evaluator checks all requirements - file existence, valid MP3 format, audio stream presence, reasonable size, duration, and bitrate
Proper MP3 format validation: Uses 'file' command to check magic bytes, ensuring file is actually MP3 audio (not just renamed file)
Audio content verification: Uses ffprobe to extract audio stream metadata, confirming valid audio stream exists
Multiple validation layers: Checks existence (150KB min), format (MP3 via magic bytes), content (audio stream), duration (>= 1s), and bitrate (32-320 kbps)
Robust edge case handling: Detects empty files, corrupt files, invalid formats, missing audio streams, and unreasonable bitrates
Logical correctness: Data flow is correct - getter extracts comprehensive properties, metric validates all critical aspects for audio extraction task
